findings.message: The variant table calls `fingerprint` directly with hand-built rows. Only one case (T2, T10, T1) runs through a real caller, `syncSpecclaw`. The second caller of the same comparison, `unchanged()` in `modules/delivery/server/push.ts:62` (sync_specclaw push), is never tested with out-of-order tasks against stored rows. Add a `pushSpecclaw` case that pushes tasks out of order twice and expects `unchanged` on the second push, so the push path is checked too.
findings.scenario: No current wrong output. Both callers share `fingerprint`, so the fix covers push today. A later change to push's `unchanged()` that rebuilt the fingerprint input without sorting would make every push of T26-before-T25 count as `updated`, and no test would fail.
